method: Five sample prompts from src/ui/index.html, sent sequentially in one signed browser session. Returned SQL was executed against the local source dataset and compared with reference values. PNG output was decoded and both charts were visually inspected.
timing_scope: Single-run end-to-end HTTP duration, including network/provider work; not a benchmark or load test.

cases.question: How many distinct delivered orders contain at least one item? Count each order only once, even if it has multiple items.
cases.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS delivered_order_count
FROM olist_orders_dataset o
JOIN olist_order_items_dataset oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered';
cases.answer: There are 96,478 distinct delivered orders that contain at least one item.

cases.question: Plot monthly total order item prices as a line chart. Join order items to orders, group by purchase month in YYYY-MM format, include all statuses and exclude freight.
cases.sql:
SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
    SUM(oi.price) AS total_price
FROM
    olist_orders_dataset o
JOIN
    olist_order_items_dataset oi
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY
    month
ORDER BY
    month
LIMIT 50;
